questions: What is a host?
If the host dies, does everything using it die too?
What is migration?
If a migration fails partway, does everything go back to where it started?
What is fusion?
If fusion fails, can development continue?
What is imprinting?
Once imprinting has happened, can it be undone?
What is a display?
If the display is brighter, does it always attract more attention?
What is a trigger?
If a trigger is pulled, does the response always happen?
What is memory?
If memory is lost, can it be rebuilt?
What is bandwidth?
If bandwidth increases, does everything get through faster?
What is a receptor?
If a receptor is blocked, does the message still get through?
What is masking?
If masking is removed, is the original signal always clear?
What is a territory?
If a territory is left unguarded, does it stay yours?
What is courtship?
If courtship succeeds, do they stay together?
What is recruitment?
If recruitment is high, does the group necessarily get bigger?
What is a drive?
If the drive is strong, does it always lead to action?
What is a load?
If the load doubles, does it take twice as much effort to move?
